content: Vihaan Patel called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to confirm the reinstatement of his health policy (SH-123456) and inquire about the updated premium amount. Neha confirmed the policy is successfully reinstated, explained that the premium is pro-rated, and noted that she has emailed the updated amount along with a payment link.

action_items: Customer to review the email sent by the agent containing the updated pro-rated premium amount and complete the payment using the provided link.
